current_reference: Training-only scaled PCA with 48 components + per-neuron Poisson GLM, alpha selected within train
current_reference_limitations: Original source 108 × 108 images are reduced to 18 × 18; full-resolution model comparisons have unequal information.
One retinal session and 30 test images with repeats, not 900 independent samples.
Poisson NLL is not published noise-corrected correlation or explained variance.
Pretrained model support is not proof of uncontaminated evaluation provenance.
recommended_next_comparator: Train a compact Goldin/OpenRetina-style CNN directly on identical 18 × 18 pixels and 41 training-count columns, using training-image validation only. Score positive expected counts for all 900 repeats under exact Poisson NLL; compare LN/nonlinear subunit models. Audit released Goldin weights for source/test-image overlap before any pretrained tier.
switching_assessment: NO GENERAL REPLACEMENT RECOMMENDATION. Current evidence supports a bounded code-synthesis/pilot comparison to the named local reference. Establish prospective same-input/split/metric contender runs, biological/source replication, calibration and runtime/reliability before switching production tools.
